Name: Running Animation Fix
Author: ggmcgee
Description: This mod changes the sideways running animation so that the Farmer swings his/her arms and legs in opposite directions like a normal person. The latest file updates both Farmer genders.

Downloads.Description: This mod changes the sideways running animation so that Farmers of all genders swing their arms and legs in opposite directions like a normal people.
